sql_injection.description: Untrusted data reaches SQL statement text and may alter the query structure.
sql_injection.impact: If externally controlled values enter query syntax, an attacker may read, change, or delete records or bypass data-access restrictions with the database connection’s privileges. Fixed queries and correctly bound parameters do not establish this condition.
sql_injection.remediation: Bind data as parameters. Choose table and column identifiers from a fixed allowlist; placeholders cannot bind identifiers.

command_injection.description: Untrusted input can change the command interpreted by a shell or command interpreter.
command_injection.impact: If an attacker controls interpreted syntax or the operation selected, code or commands may run with the application’s privileges, allowing data theft, state changes, or service disruption.
command_injection.remediation: Use a fixed executable and argument array without a shell. Validate arguments for the executable being called.

xss.description: Untrusted data reaches HTML output without a modeled encoding step.
xss.impact: If attacker-controlled content reaches an executable browser context, it may run under the application’s origin, read accessible session data, or perform actions with the victim’s permissions.
xss.remediation: Encode for the precise output context; use HTML encoding for text and quoted attributes, and dedicated encoders for JavaScript and URLs.

ssrf.description: Untrusted input controls the destination of a server-side request.
ssrf.impact: If an attacker can select a reachable destination, the application may expose internal services or metadata credentials, or send protected data to an unauthorized recipient.
ssrf.remediation: Allowlist destinations and protocols, reject internal addresses, and validate redirect targets and resolved addresses.

path_traversal.description: External input controls the path used by a filesystem operation. Resolve the intended root and effective containment checks.
path_traversal.impact: An attacker controlling a path or shared file may read or replace private files, delete data, or redirect an operation outside its intended directory if containment and access controls are ineffective.
path_traversal.remediation: Resolve paths beneath a fixed root and verify containment before access. Account for symlinks and concurrent filesystem changes.

arbitrary_file_write.description: External input controls the destination of a file-write operation. Resolve whether it can escape the intended writable directory.
arbitrary_file_write.impact: An attacker who selects a destination outside the permitted directory may overwrite application code or configuration, corrupt data, or establish persistence with the application’s write privileges.
arbitrary_file_write.remediation: Resolve paths beneath a fixed root and verify containment before access. Account for symlinks and concurrent filesystem changes.

insecure_deserialization.description: Attacker-controlled serialized data reaches object construction.
insecure_deserialization.impact: A crafted untrusted payload may instantiate dangerous types or trigger object behavior that executes code, modifies state, or exhausts resources when the parser permits those operations.
insecure_deserialization.remediation: Prefer a data-only format such as JSON. Do not trust a type or signature flag supplied inside the same untrusted payload.

file_inclusion.description: Untrusted data reaches a PHP include or require operation.
file_inclusion.impact: An attacker controlling a path or shared file may read or replace private files, delete data, or redirect an operation outside its intended directory if containment and access controls are ineffective.
file_inclusion.remediation: Select include targets from a fixed allowlist of application files.

xxe.description: Untrusted XML reaches parsing with entity expansion or external DTD loading enabled.
xxe.impact: If external resources or entity expansion are permitted for untrusted XML, an attacker may read local files, make requests to internal services, or exhaust parser resources.
xxe.remediation: Disable external entity and DTD loading; use safe parser flags and a restrictive resolver.

code_injection.description: Externally influenced data reaches an operation that interprets a string as executable code. Determine the value actually supplied to the interpreter or timer and whether it is a string or a callable.
code_injection.impact: If an attacker controls interpreted syntax or the operation selected, code or commands may run with the application’s privileges, allowing data theft, state changes, or service disruption.
code_injection.remediation: Replace runtime code evaluation with fixed operations and data-only inputs.

open_redirect.description: Untrusted data reaches a redirect or response header.
open_redirect.impact: A crafted destination or link may direct users to a phishing site, leak URL-carried secrets, or trigger unauthorized operations if routing trusts external parameters without the required access checks.
open_redirect.remediation: Allowlist redirect destinations and reject response-header control characters.

weak_hash.description: A weak cryptographic or non-cryptographic random primitive is used; confirm its security purpose.
weak_hash.impact: Predictable secrets or unsuitable cryptographic parameters may enable credential guessing, reveal plaintext, or weaken integrity when used to protect security-sensitive data. Non-security hashes and identifiers do not establish this condition.
weak_hash.remediation: Use a modern purpose-appropriate primitive and a cryptographically secure random generator for secrets.

buffer_overflow.description: An indexed or pointer-based write may exceed its allocation bounds.
buffer_overflow.impact: An attacker may corrupt memory, alter control flow, or execute code if they can influence the violating write.
buffer_overflow.remediation: Validate offsets and lengths against the allocation before writing and use bounded APIs.

format_string.description: Externally influenced text reaches a formatting operation where it may control the format specification.
format_string.impact: An attacker-controlled format string may disclose process memory, write to unintended memory, or crash the process, depending on the formatting API.
format_string.remediation: Keep format specifications constant and pass external text only as data arguments. Use type-safe formatting and validate lengths and argument types.

expression_injection.description: A reachable dynamic evaluation operation interprets externally influenced content as code.
expression_injection.impact: Attacker-controlled code may run in the application’s security context, exposing protected data or modifying trusted state.
expression_injection.remediation: Replace dynamic evaluation with fixed operations and data-only inputs; do not rely on ad hoc filtering of executable syntax.

ssti.description: A reachable dynamic evaluation operation interprets externally influenced content as code.
ssti.impact: Attacker-controlled code may run in the application’s security context, exposing protected data or modifying trusted state.
ssti.remediation: Replace dynamic evaluation with fixed operations and data-only inputs; do not rely on ad hoc filtering of executable syntax.

template_injection.description: A reachable dynamic evaluation operation interprets externally influenced content as code.
template_injection.impact: Attacker-controlled code may run in the application’s security context, exposing protected data or modifying trusted state.
template_injection.remediation: Replace dynamic evaluation with fixed operations and data-only inputs; do not rely on ad hoc filtering of executable syntax.

sandbox_escape.description: A reachable dynamic evaluation operation interprets externally influenced content as code.
sandbox_escape.impact: Attacker-controlled code may run in the application’s security context, exposing protected data or modifying trusted state.
sandbox_escape.remediation: Replace dynamic evaluation with fixed operations and data-only inputs; do not rely on ad hoc filtering of executable syntax.

component_exposure.description: An Android component or receiver exposes an entry point with a weak or unresolved caller permission boundary. Manifest merging and runtime authorization may affect the effective policy.
component_exposure.impact: An unauthorized application may invoke exposed operations, read protected data, or change application state if no effective caller check protects the entry point.
component_exposure.remediation: Disable external access when it is unnecessary. Otherwise use suitable signature permissions or explicit caller authorization, validate all incoming data, and test access from an untrusted application.

content_provider_exposure.description: An Android component or receiver exposes an entry point with a weak or unresolved caller permission boundary. Manifest merging and runtime authorization may affect the effective policy.
content_provider_exposure.impact: An unauthorized application may invoke exposed operations, read protected data, or change application state if no effective caller check protects the entry point.
content_provider_exposure.remediation: Disable external access when it is unnecessary. Otherwise use suitable signature permissions or explicit caller authorization, validate all incoming data, and test access from an untrusted application.

binder_exposure.description: An Android component or receiver exposes an entry point with a weak or unresolved caller permission boundary. Manifest merging and runtime authorization may affect the effective policy.
binder_exposure.impact: An unauthorized application may invoke exposed operations, read protected data, or change application state if no effective caller check protects the entry point.
binder_exposure.remediation: Disable external access when it is unnecessary. Otherwise use suitable signature permissions or explicit caller authorization, validate all incoming data, and test access from an untrusted application.

deep_link_exposure.description: The application registers or parses an externally supplied URI or link. Registration alone does not establish unsafe routing or authorization.
deep_link_exposure.impact: A crafted link may trigger unauthorized actions, redirect navigation, or expose private data if the receiving handler trusts URI fields or bypasses authentication and object-level authorization.
deep_link_exposure.remediation: Allowlist accepted schemes, hosts, paths, and operations. Validate link parameters, require authorization before sensitive actions, and verify domain association when relying on trusted web links.

insecure_transport.description: The effective transport policy may permit insecure HTTP content or relax transport protections for a WebView, media request, domain, or application.
insecure_transport.impact: A network attacker may read or modify affected cleartext traffic. Modified executable web content may also compromise the containing WebView session or exposed native interfaces.
insecure_transport.remediation: Use HTTPS with normal certificate validation. Remove unnecessary transport exceptions, keep any unavoidable exception narrowly scoped, and avoid sending credentials or loading executable content over cleartext connections.

javascript_injection.description: The application exposes a native bridge or message handler to web content.
javascript_injection.impact: Untrusted web content may invoke native operations with the application’s privileges if origin restrictions, message validation, or per-operation authorization are missing.
javascript_injection.remediation: Expose only narrowly required native methods. Restrict loaded origins and message senders, validate message schemas, and authorize every sensitive native action.

pendingintent_injection.description: Intent or PendingIntent configuration permits mutation, unsafe implicit delivery, or bypass of intent-redirection protection. Resolve the intended recipient and effective flags.
pendingintent_injection.impact: An untrusted recipient or input may redirect execution or alter an operation performed under the application’s identity if mutable fields or an implicit target cross a trust boundary.
pendingintent_injection.remediation: Prefer explicit destinations and immutable PendingIntents. Where mutation is required, tightly constrain recipients and fill-in fields, validate nested intents, and retain platform redirection protections.

certificate_validation_bypass.description: The checked code or configuration bypasses a certificate, hostname, or server-trust decision. Resolve the effective callback and build configuration before confirming a production bypass.
certificate_validation_bypass.impact: A network attacker may impersonate the intended server and read or modify traffic if the bypass accepts an untrusted certificate or mismatched hostname on a reachable connection.
certificate_validation_bypass.remediation: Restore platform certificate-chain and hostname validation. Reject invalid server trust, remove permissive callbacks and environment overrides from production, and use properly configured test trust stores for development.

bridge_exposure.description: The application exposes a native bridge or message handler to web content.
bridge_exposure.impact: Untrusted web content may invoke native operations with the application’s privileges if origin restrictions, message validation, or per-operation authorization are missing.
bridge_exposure.remediation: Expose only narrowly required native methods. Restrict loaded origins and message senders, validate message schemas, and authorize every sensitive native action.

nosql_injection.description: Externally influenced data reaches a document-database query or operator structure.
nosql_injection.impact: An attacker may alter filtering, bypass authentication predicates, or obtain or modify records outside the intended selection if they control query operators or expression syntax.
nosql_injection.remediation: Construct queries with a fixed schema, validate values and types, reject externally supplied operator keys, and enforce record-level authorization.

ldap_injection.description: External data reaches a directory query, XPath expression, or naming-service lookup. Resolve whether it controls expression syntax or a remote lookup target.
ldap_injection.impact: An attacker may change intended record selection or access a protected directory or naming destination; unsafe remote resolution may also execute code depending on the runtime and reachable providers.
ldap_injection.remediation: Keep lookup targets fixed and trusted. Use context-appropriate binding or escaping for values, reject externally controlled expression structure, and restrict service permissions.

xpath_injection.description: External data reaches a directory query, XPath expression, or naming-service lookup. Resolve whether it controls expression syntax or a remote lookup target.
xpath_injection.impact: An attacker may change intended record selection or access a protected directory or naming destination; unsafe remote resolution may also execute code depending on the runtime and reachable providers.
xpath_injection.remediation: Keep lookup targets fixed and trusted. Use context-appropriate binding or escaping for values, reject externally controlled expression structure, and restrict service permissions.

jndi_injection.description: External data reaches a directory query, XPath expression, or naming-service lookup. Resolve whether it controls expression syntax or a remote lookup target.
jndi_injection.impact: An attacker may change intended record selection or access a protected directory or naming destination; unsafe remote resolution may also execute code depending on the runtime and reachable providers.
jndi_injection.remediation: Keep lookup targets fixed and trusted. Use context-appropriate binding or escaping for values, reject externally controlled expression structure, and restrict service permissions.

email_header_injection.description: Externally influenced values reach email header construction.
email_header_injection.impact: An attacker may add recipients or alter message routing and headers, disclosing message content or using the application to send unauthorized mail.
email_header_injection.remediation: Reject CR and LF in header values, use a structured mail API, validate intended recipients, and keep message-body data separate from headers.

unrestricted_file_upload.description: Externally supplied upload content reaches a storage or processing operation without an established content boundary.
unrestricted_file_upload.impact: A crafted upload may execute as application code, overwrite files, expose data through processing, or exhaust storage if the destination and processing controls allow it.
unrestricted_file_upload.remediation: Allowlist required content types, validate actual content, limit size, generate server-side filenames, and store uploads outside executable paths with access controls.

log_injection.description: Externally influenced values reach log output without an established record-integrity boundary.
log_injection.impact: An attacker may forge or obscure log entries and mislead investigation or monitoring; sensitive values included in the output may also be disclosed to log readers.
log_injection.remediation: Use structured logging, encode control characters, redact secrets before emission, and protect log access and integrity.

project_marker.description: The source contains a project or framework marker. This identifies review scope rather than a security defect.
project_marker.impact: No adverse security consequence follows from the marker alone; no confidentiality, integrity, or availability failure has been established.
project_marker.remediation: Use the marker to select the applicable review and analysis scope. Require concrete evidence of a failed security control before recommending a corrective change.
